item.title: Very deep pathole...around 8-10 cm , with sharp edges..., 17th November
item.description:
Urgent Hazard: Deep pothole on Preston's Road (junction with Trafalgar Way), E14 There is a dangerously deep sunken utility access cover / square pothole (approximately 8–10 cm / 80–100 mm deep, as shown against a standard bottle in the attached photos) on the carriageway of Preston's Road, just south of the Preston's Road roundabout at the junction with Trafalgar Way (outside the red brick building / 32 Arniston Way, next to the green utility cabinet and the blue signpost towards Blackwall DLR Station). Because the depression is filled with rainwater and covered with fallen leaves, it is completely invisible at night. My vehicle struck this sharp-edged hazard in the dark, causing a heavy impact that may have damaged the wheel and suspension. Please treat this as an urgent safety hazard and log this report for reference.

Report on FixMyStreet
